responsibility: Acts as the master declarative catalog of RISC-V ISA extensions known to the backend. It defines the `DEFINE_RISCV_EXT` schema and then enumerates standard, privileged, and vendor extension entries with their canonical names, version tuples, dependency rules, grouping into extension-mask variables, feature-bit assignments, and special flags such as macro-only extensions; this table is the single source consumed by generators like `gen-riscv-ext-opt.cc` and `gen-riscv-ext-texi.cc` to build option masks and manual documentation, and it includes the vendor-specific `.def` fragments at the end.
same_name_distinction: Unlike riscv-ext.opt, this is the authoritative hand-maintained definition source: it declares each extension with metadata such as dependencies, supported versions, grouping, feature-bit allocation, and flags, and even includes vendor-specific .def fragments. The sibling .opt file is generated from this catalog rather than defining the extension inventory itself.
